Rotation.RotationNotes:
Resto BG/arena (merged from Arena profile you liked). Talent 11/0/60.
LAYERS (top → bottom — order IS priority): 1. Self: PvP trinket break, Barkskin (HP/burst/stun/silence), NS+HT self, Swiftmend self, Nature's Grasp, Berserker Rage fear-break. 2. Ally emergency: NS+HT save, Swiftmend, Wild Growth, Nourish. 3. Dispels + peel: Abolish/Remove Curse on pressured unit only, Bear powershift roots/snares. 4. HoTs: pandemic Rejuv (<3s refresh), Lifebloom stack, Regrowth only if HoT missing. 5. Support: WG maintenance (2+ low), on-use trinkets/gloves, Innervate <50% mana, War Stomp. 6. Defaults: Tranquility (5+ low / self panic), Healing Touch (no HoT), Nourish (any HoT). 7. Focus: Cyclone, Roots, Faerie Fire — only if layers 1–6 did not need a GCD; skipped while ArenaSelfDanger.
HEAL ENGINE: incoming-damage scoring (5s HP window), self-override at HP<40 / <65+drop>25 / <80+drop>40. LoS via IsSpellInRange(Healing Touch).
DO NOT TARGET A FRIENDLY. Left Ctrl pauses. /focus enemy healer.
TEST: /run PQR_TestMode = true. Disable: /run PQR_TestMode = nil. Watch [Arena] chat tags.
